verdict.rationale: Statsig documents targeting rules on gates: a tutorial targets mobile platforms and internal testers, and the docs say multiple targeting rules can be layered with per-user overrides. That shows attribute-based targeting, but nothing in the pack describes reusable segments shared across flags. missing for 10: documented reusable segments, detail on the attribute/operator rule model, independent or hands-on corroboration of targeting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: This tutorial creates a feature gate, targets mobile platforms and internal testers
You can also layer multiple targeting rules and set overrides to force specific users into a variant for testing or QA.
set up Feature Gate overrides to allow specific users to bypass the gate.
